title.en: Theory of Becoming — current first priority
title.zh: 生成／变化之论——当前首要研究方向

scope.en: Ren's current first priority for the continuing foundation programme: explain the whole scope of becoming, including generation and degeneration. Preserve completed ethical and evolutionary results and the scopes of independently authorized tasks. Ren clarifies that deductive necessity concerns the whole Theory of Becoming; generativity is within its manifold.
scope.zh: Ren 为持续基础研究确立的当前首要方向：解释包含生成与退化的整个变化范围。保留已完成伦理、演化成果及其他独立授权任务的范围。 Ren进一步明确：演绎必然性的对象是Theory of Becoming整体；生成性是其manifold的部分。

objective.en: Establish the deductive necessity of the Theory of Becoming as a whole without added substantive axioms; explain generative forms within its manifold. Articulate how relations form, persist, transform and dissolve, including life and evolution, without requiring every becoming to be generative or favorably directed.
objective.zh: 无需附加实质公理，建立Theory of Becoming整体的演绎必然性，并说明其manifold中的生成形态。阐明关系怎样形成、维持、转化与消失，包含生命与演化，不要求每种变化均有生成性或有利方向。

premises.en: Begin with the monist relational method and disclose its role. Retain mixed effects, real losses and terminal continuations. Distinguish logical machinery, definitions, local laws, correspondence and normative commitments; a supplied local law is not thereby external to reality. The theory asserts no axiom: everything that holds for any significance is stated without one, living significance is characterized and shown undecided by the dynamics, and the continuation condition (for anything, its continuation into the future has significance) enters only as the condition of chapter section 6.15, under which living significance is a theorem. Courses are compared on possibilities. The generative space is stated with no axiom: a part is generative where the levels with it widen those without it, and on level paths comparison is a law with “better” read as widening; under the continuation condition, widening is retaining and adding what has significance. The practical commitments of the alignment route stay explicit within the whole, without becoming premises of every dynamical explanation.
premises.zh: 从一元关系方法出发并公开其作用。保留混合效果、真实损失与终结的延续。区分逻辑工具、定义、局部规律、对应与规范承诺；给定的局部规律并不因此外在于实在。理论不断言任何公理：凡对任何意义成立者都无需公理陈述；生命的意义得到刻画，且动力学不决定它；延续条件（任何东西向未来的延续都有意义）只作为章节 §6.15 的条件出现，在此条件下生命的意义是定理。各进程按可能性比较。生成空间无需公理陈述：一个部分在“有它”的层级扩展了“无它”的层级之处是生成的；在层级路径上，以“更好”读作扩展，比较是规律；在延续条件下，扩展即保留并增加有意义者。对齐路线的实践承诺在整体之内保持明示，不成为每个动力学解释的前提。

completion.en: Reuse completed conditional mechanisms and identify the exact remaining foundational inference. Assess zero normative axioms and zero added substantive axioms separately; neither outcome inclusion, an empty Lean axiom report nor hidden hypotheses establishes the stronger target. Explain actual possibilities and constraints, expose remaining dependencies, and preserve substantive counterexamples. This priority authorization does not certify a new result or universal completion. Establish the whole claim at its stated scope; do not substitute universal generativity for the whole or treat a mode’s absence as its refutation.
completion.zh: 复用已完成条件机制，指出尚缺的确切基础推论。分别检验无规范公理与无附加实质公理；包容全部结果、空 Lean 公理报告或隐藏假设都不等于更强目标成立。说明实际可能与限制，公开剩余依赖并保留实质反例。本优先授权不认证新成果或普遍完成。 按所声明范围建立整体主张；不以普遍生成性替换整体，不把某种形态缺失直接视为整体反例。

title.zh: 首要研究方向：生成／变化之论

summary.en: Deductive necessity lies in the Theory of Becoming as a whole; generativity is within its manifold. Develop that deduction without added substantive axioms, retaining persistence, degeneration, dissolution and mixed changes. Life, evolution and evaluation under the conditional alignment route remain differentiated within the same reality.
summary.zh: 整体Theory of Becoming是演绎必然性的对象，生成性是其manifold中的部分。无需附加实质公理推进这一演绎，保留维持、退化、消解及混合变化；生命、演化与有条件的对齐路线下的评价在同一现实中分化。

next_step.en: Establish the deductive necessity of the whole: that its determinations are internally related moments of one unfolding, not a collection of laws each holding of every represented world. Settle whether every becoming can be represented with discrete steps and natural-number amounts, on which rest, novelty needing gain and the setting of runaway by frequency depend, and state the laws with real amounts and continuous time. The zero-premise line of 11 October is carried through: the laws of the theory without axiom are stated for every world so represented, each with its local conditions written into it; the counting laws that needed decided activity also hold over counted censuses, with no decision procedure; naming, for every finite world meeting the eight premises, a step after which nothing arises would give the limited principle of omniscience (`World.lpo_of_finite_ends`); and the commitments of the representation are stated on the premise card.
next_step.zh: 确立整体的演绎必然性：其诸规定是同一展开中内在相关的环节，而非各自对每个被表示世界成立的一组规律。判明每个生成／变化能否以离散步与自然数量表示（停息、新颖需要增益、由频率决定失控都依赖于此），并陈述实数量与连续时间下的规律。10月11日的零前提路线已完成：无公理理论的各条规律对每个如此表示的世界成立，各自的局部条件写在规律之内；原需可判定活动的计数规律，在计数普查上无需判定程序同样成立；对满足八个前提的每个有限世界指出此后不再有生起的一步，将给出有限全知原理（`World.lpo_of_finite_ends`）；表示的承诺列于前提卡。
